annotations.title: How to start a project in VEDUTUM

description: Says where to begin. Without a connected account: the links to open one or sign in, and the four steps from floor plan to share page. With the account connected: how many projects it has and, while it has none, the usual first steps in order (the example house in 3D with vedutum_view_model, then reading a floor plan of one’s own). Use when someone has just connected VEDUTUM, asks what it can do, or wants to try it with their own plan. Creates nothing.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".
